title: Off-shell Hessian thermodynamic stability of higher-curvature black holes
summary: We develop a branch-sensitive thermodynamic framework for higher-curvature black holes using the off-shell Gibbs free energy $G_{\rm off}$ and the Wald entropy$S_W$ as the basic data. On fixed-parameter slices, equilibrium black holes are stationary points of $G_{\rm off}$, and their local stability is governed by the Hessian $H=S'_W(r_h)T'(r_h)$, rather than by the temperature slope alone.
